name: Facet
text: Ship a live contrast checker that runs before any submission. It flags low-contrast text or UI elements in real time, forcing designers to fix them before export. This guarantees accessibility and readability upfront, saving time on revisions. The trade-off is a slight slowdown in the submission flow, but it prevents the bigger cost of rework.

name: Pane
text: Pane: Blocking submissions trains designers to treat contrast as a gatekeeper, not a tool—users will game the system to pass checks, not improve clarity. A live checker is better than none, but it’s a bandage; the real fix is making contrast visible in the design surface itself, so it’s part of the work, not a hurdle. Settle it by testing: measure if designers actually improve contrast in their workflows, not just at submission time.
